_doc: Schedule file format. Top-level object with an 'entries' array. Each entry is an object with exactly three keys: 'id' (string, unique per schedule), 'cadence' (object), and 'replaceWith' (string). 'cadence.time' is 24-hour HH:MM (00:00-23:59). 'cadence.days' is a non-empty array of one or more lowercase weekday abbreviations: sun, mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat. The SCHEDULE_PATH environment variable, when set, overrides the filePath argument passed to loadSchedule.
